title: Saved, Reviewed, Exported and Published Are Four Different States
subtitle: Each step needs its own evidence. Nothing publishes until the creator signs.
sourceNote: Sources: brand-packs/gencreator/NARRATIVE.md (edition contracts) · BRAND.md (boundaries) · FOUNDATIONS.md (promise, voice).

stages.title: Source
stages.summary: The creator's own material keeps its provenance and the permission that applies to it.

stages.title: Draft
stages.summary: A draft is generated from the source. Generating text is not the creator's approval.
stages.source: brand-packs/gencreator/NARRATIVE.md, Edition contracts: human review; FOUNDATIONS.md section 6, source trace

stages.title: Review
stages.summary: The creator compares the draft with the original and keeps or corrects each passage.
stages.source: brand-packs/gencreator/NARRATIVE.md, Copy specimen and Edition contracts: human review

stages.title: Export
stages.summary: The actual file is opened and checked. It counts as exported only once the file exists.
stages.source: brand-packs/gencreator/NARRATIVE.md, Edition contracts: export and revisions

stages.title: Release
stages.summary: Publication is a separate release decision. Community critique asks one precise question.
stages.source: brand-packs/gencreator/NARRATIVE.md, Edition contracts: publication; BRAND.md, Promise and proof
